class.name: MaszynaBTFTerrainWriter
class.brief_description: Makes the original's binary terrain file (.btf) of a text terrain file (.txtf).
class.description: Writes what the original writes before it loads a text terrain file: the [code]triangles[/code] of the text put in the cells of the original's 1 km sections, a triangle reaching more than 200 m out of its section cut at the section's edge, and the shapes of one material, lighting and range within 25 m of each other merged. The file is read by [MaszynaBTFTerrainProvider], so a terrain kept as text is streamed as one kept in binary. A text that holds anything but [code]triangles[/code] nodes is not written; the scenery reads it as text, as the original does.

method.name: checksum
method.description: The CRC-32 of zlib of [param data], as the original checks the text of a binary terrain file and the slices of a heightmap terrain's packs.

method.name: write
method.description: Writes the binary file of the text at [param text_path] to [param binary_path], its folders made, replacing a file there in one go. Returns [code]false[/code], with the reason reported, when the text holds a node of another type or a word outside a node, or the file cannot be written.
